name: dumbbell sitting good morning
description: A seated good morning with a dumbbell held at your chest, bowing forward to train the lower back with less leg involvement.
instructions: Sit on a bench with feet flat and hold a dumbbell against your chest.
Sit tall and brace your core.
Hinge forward from the hips, keeping your back flat.
Stop when your torso is about halfway down.
Squeeze your back and glutes to sit tall again.
